about: Vendors and what they sell. fv: players' ForeverDB addon saw what it sells in Forever; met: the NPC is in Forever (the game cache, or opened with an empty list) but its stock is Classic's; the rest are Classic vendors (CMaNGOS classic-db). Prices are the Forever client's, or what players paid without their discounts; lim: limited supply; cl: a Classic limited-supply item a seen vendor's list didn't have (sold out when the player looked, or gone in Forever). rf: the faction whose reputation gives the vendor's discount (the client's FactionTemplate for the CMaNGOS creature; names in "factions").

515.d: Awarded for winning games or doing favors at the Darkmoon Faire.

1792.d: Honor is gained by killing members of the opposite faction in PvP combat. You can use honor points to purchase special items.

3402.d: Worth a considerable amount of gold and thus used as an interim currency among high-traffic merchant organizations. Members of the Durotar Supply and Logistics or Azeroth Commerce Authority would be willing to trade for this.

3468.d: Rank points are gained by completing tasks given in Gadgetzan or participating in battlegrounds. Rank points increase your PvP Rank which grants you access to purchase special items.

3469.d: This currency is slowly being phased out of circulation, but it still enjoys a very favorable exchange rate at goblin towns throughout the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.
